programme.title: The Boy Behind The Door

programme.title: The Eyes
programme.desc: The story begins after Trang, a famous artiste, awakens from coma following a horrific car accident. The traumatic injury leaves her with memory loss. She also has to undergo eye transplant surgery to regain her vision. But right after the surgery, Trang starts seeing a lady ghost with bloodshot eyes following her around. She decides to investigate the spooky encounters and discovers unimaginable secrets that her very own husband has been trying to hide from her.

programme.title: Midnight Horror
programme.desc: An aspiring flight attendant named Soo-hyeon agrees to a one-week part time job at a convenience store that pays suspiciously too well. programme.title: Midnight Horror
programme.desc: Jin-kyeong, an emergency counselor from the suicide hotline, listens to the lamenting stories of suicidal people. However, one night, she picks up the call to hear her dead brother's voice on the line and Jin-kyeong is gripped with fear that she can't escape.

programme.title: The Block
programme.desc: A group of 4 friends who call themselves the Black Cat, specializes in posting videos of mysterious and haunted places, in order to gain fame on YouTube. One night, they break into Workshop 13, an abandoned sewing factory, where a security guard had hanged himself. On entering, they are greeted by the cold gaze of three mannequins.

programme.title: Iblis Dalam Darah
programme.desc: Haruni is possessed by a demon who often compels her to hurt herself. Distraught, her younger sister, Hanum, unloads her woes to her eye doctor, Ahmad, who is also a religious person. Curious, he offers to attend Haruni's exorcism. But during the midst of the session, he realises that the demon within Haruni is related to a recent suicide case.

programme.title: Spicy Killers
programme.desc: Kisah ibu dan 3 anak perempuannya yang hidup diselubungi ketakutan akibat didera oleh ayah mereka menyebabkan kehidupan mereka penuh dengan dendam dan tragedi berdarah.

programme.title: Jangan Pandang Belakang Boleh?
programme.desc: Rose, Dharma's girlfriend, dies by suicide. Dharma and Rose's twin sister Seri cannot accept that Rose would take her own life. Indra, Dharma's colleague, also tries to help Dharma figure out Rose's death. During their investigations, Dharma is disturbed by all kinds of ghostly happenings. Indra and Seri do not believe in the supernatural and think that Dharma is making up all these things. In fact, Seri starts accusing Dharma of causing her twin to kill herself. Dharma must solve this puzzle as soon as he can.

programme.title: Kakak
programme.desc: Adi and Kirana have been married for a long time but are still childless. Kirana's body is weak due to her asthma and has experienced three miscarriages, causing stress and depression. They still live with Adi's mother, Aida, who doesn't approve of Kirana mostly because she's been unable to bear a child. Trying to relieve his wife's stress, Adi decides that a move to a neighborhood outside of town would be the best for them both. Kirana starts to feel that there is something strange with their new home, that something else is present with them.

programme.title: Bldg. N
programme.desc: Shiori is a university student and she suffers from an extreme fear of death. Along with her schoolmates Keita and Maho, they scout a location for Keita's graduation film project. The location is an abandoned apartment complex that is infamous for paranormal sightings. The students meet the mysterious residents of the abandoned apartment complex. The residents believe that they are living with ghosts in the apartment. Keita and Maho become frightened and want to leave right away, but Shiori is sceptical and believes the supernatural phenomena are fake. She convinces her friends that they should investigate the claims.

programme.title: Kerat 14
programme.desc: Haziq dan Nuzara merupakan pasangan kekasih dan Haziq amat menyayangi Nurzara, namun Haziq terlibat dengan aktiviti sosial dan tidak disenangi oleh Nuzara. Dalam masa yang sama Aril muncul dan mula tertarik dengan kecantikan Nuzara ketika Nuzara dan Haziq berada di salah sebuah kelab di Kuala Lumpur. Sebuah tragedi ngeri yang tidak disengajakan telah berlaku dalam kisah cinta Haziq dan Nuzara dan penyiasatan dilakukan oleh ASP Razman.

After a while, Kanaya begins to notice odd happenings occuring in their new home.
